programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Wild Mongolia: Land of Extremes
programme.desc: Landlocked and bordering both China and Russia, Mongolia is a land of extreme habitats. From the challenging environment of the Gobi desert situated on a mounain plateau to the vast grasslands of the Mongolian Steppe, from the Altai mountains to the Taiga forest in the north of the country, this land is home to some of the hardiest and most resilient animals on the planet. The show explores the topography these distinct environments and chronicles how the wildlife has evolved and adapted so that they can either live with littel access to water or else become totally dependent on grass for their survival.

programme.title: Wild Hunters: Deadly Killers of Africa
programme.desc: Journey across Africa exploring the continent's most iconic and deadliest predators. These African stories are a show of raw power, strength and endurance. An awe-inspiring display of the fierce, everyday battles fought in the wild.

programme.title: World's Creepiest Killers
programme.desc: Giant spiders, voracious blobs and swamp things are the stuff of horror movies - but these creepy killers are real!

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin ventures into Australia's notorious wetlands to discover three animals built for the muggy and wet environment. Phil comes face to face with the uniquely Australian freshwater crocodile, a massive predatory fish called the barramundi, and the saltwater crocodile, one of the world's most dangerous animals and largest reptiles.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads along the cliffs and sandy flats of the Australian coast to discover which animal dominates the shoreline. His first encounter is with a white -bellied sea eagle, a bird with extremely sharp talons, followed by the estuarine stonefish, the most venomous fish in the world. Finally, Phil takes a closer look at the notorious stingray.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the mangroves to discover which animal is truly built to survive the mud and muck. He encounters a feisty mud crab with huge pincers and catches a shovel-nosed ray with his bare hands. Finally, Phil faces a creature we all love to hate—the mosquito—and discovers there's more to these tiny bloodsuckers than meets the eye.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads to the mysterious blue depths to discover which animal dominates the sea. His first encounter is with a tiger shark, the notorious hunter shaped like a torpedo and armed with ferocious teeth! Next, Phil dives with a group of magnificent manta rays and listens to the songs of one of the largest creatures on Earth, the majestic humpback whale.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how lions hunt large prey like buffalo and zebra, offering new perspectives on the way these predators stalk, chase and kill. A lone lioness relies on cunning to feed her newborn cubs, whilst a fearless pride tries to take down the biggest prey of all, a giant African elephant.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin leaves the Australian mainland to discover which of the island-dwelling animals is truly built to survive. First up, he meets the enigmatic green turtle on the Wellesley Islands. Next, he is on K'Gari (Fraser Island), where he tracks down a pack of the notorious dingoes. Finally, he encounters the formidable and aptly named death adder snake.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin dares into the Australian savannah to find the species most built to survive. First is Australia's largest bird of prey, the majestic but intimidating wedge-tailed eagle. Next, Phil tracks down one of the world's deadliest snakes, the coastal taipan. Finally, Phil faces the uniquely Australian frill-necked lizard, a reptile with fascinating defense mechanisms.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Rule of the kingdom is reserved only for the strong. Five heroes, each with a unique power, head up rival families struggling for power, clawing their way to the top. The winners are rewarded with the richest hunting grounds in the kingdom, but the fate of the losers is brutal - exile or death. Fighting to survive, killing to succeed - nothing will stop them trying to reign supreme over the Savage Kingdom.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi National Park spans over 3,000 square miles of western Tanzania. Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise

programme.title: Savage Kingdom

Fighting to survive, killing to succeed - nothing will stop them trying to reign supreme over the Savage Kingdom.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia's most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: Cold Fish:The deranged Caped Cod has escaped and vows to destroy Petropolis by melting a giant Ice bird Iceberg for the Riceberg Wedding and flooding the city! Dudley's not sure who the real enemy is - the Caped Cod or the pants Dudley has to wear to stay warm enough to defeat him! Lie Like a Dog: While playing hooky from work, Dudley does some pretty heroic things but can't take credit for them without admitting he's been lying!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Commissioner flips his lid, literally. His toupee blows off and sticks to Maurice, who also gets red cheeks and a skinned tail, all by accident. Julien and Mort chase him with sticks, intent on beating the "monster" stuck to Maurice's head. The baboon ladies take Maurice in, protecting and pampering him because they mistakenly think he's a male baboon. It's up to the penguins to get the toupee back and restore it to its rightful scalp. // Shelly the ostrich gets stuck in drying cement and only Rico can save her. Shelly falls for him hard as a result, however, Rico's heart forever belongs to his doll. Shelly swipes the doll and tries hard to win his heart, but Rico doesn't budge and his doll is accidently hauled off in a recycle truck. The penguins give chase but are left hopelessly in the dust. Shelly, wanting to make amends, tosses them on her back and sprints after the truck - can she possibly catch it?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "HALF-HOUR SUMMER VACATION SPECIAL The penguin's worst nightmare has come true. After a sailing trip gone wrong they wind up in the Hoboken Zoo. Strangely, the animals are happy, the zoo is a paradise, and life couldn't be better! Zookeeper Frances takes outstanding care of all of them or does she? Something sinister bubbles under the surface the happy animals are actually androids, and the real animals are held captive in a dungeon. They're too messy and Zookeeper Frances can't stand a mess! A rescue comes from a very unlikely source, and the final battle could go either way!".

programme.title: Bundeslyga. Miuncheno "Bayern" - „Hamburger SV“
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Osero AJ - Monako AS
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: La Liga. Madrido „Getafe“ - Ovjedo „Real“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Per due volte crede di averle trovato l'uomo giusto, ma entrambe le volte finira' per sbagliarsi. Questo suo voler decidere dei destini altrui la mettera' nei guai finche', fra sorprese e malintesi, cadra' lei stessa vittima delle maglie dell'amore. programme.desc: Guido Caprino prova a riprendere in mano la sua vita nel film di Ciro D'Emilio. La vita di Bernardo cambia drasticamente quando viene incarcerato con l'accusa di associazione a delinquere.

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe alla pellicola di Clint Eastwood che, dopo "Flags of Our Fathers", torna ad affrontare la battaglia di Iwo Jima ma questa volta dal punto di vista giapponese.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Me contro Te: Il film - Vacanze in Transilvania
programme.desc: Sofi', Lui' e i loro amici volano in Transilvania per impedire a Viperiana e alla banda di Malefici di impossessarsi di un potente diamante custodito nel castello del piu' temuto dei vampiri: il Conte Dracula.

programme.title: Shaun, vita da pecora - Farmageddon
programme.desc: Il secondo film ispirato alla serie animata si tinge di fantascienza. Shaun e i suoi amici devono difendere dagli agenti del governo una piccola aliena atterrata nella fattoria.

programme.title: Pets - Vita da animali
programme.desc: Animali domestici all'arrembaggio nel successo d'animazione targato Illumination. Il tenero cagnolino Max si allea con il randagio Duke per fermare il piano del coniglio Nevosetto.

programme.title: La bussola d'oro
programme.desc: Un Oscar al fantasy con Daniel Craig e Nicole Kidman, dal romanzo di Philip Pullman. Una bambina e il suo 'daimon' devono sfidare una strega in un luogo popolato da strane creature.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer 2
programme.desc: Sequel del capolavoro d'animazione Dreamworks. Il giovane vichingo Hiccup e il suo fedele amico Sdentato difendono il loro villaggio da un temibile drago rinnegato.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer - Il mondo nascosto
programme.desc: Terzo toccante capitolo della trilogia di successo targata DreamWorks. La minaccia di Grimmel il Grifagno costringe Hiccup e Sdentato a partire verso un luogo leggendario.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Il cacciatore e la regina di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Prequel di 'Biancaneve e il cacciatore' con Charlize Theron, Chris Hemsworth e Jessica Chastain. Un cacciatore e una guerriera difendono la Terra incantata da due streghe maligne.

programme.title: Non si scherza col fuoco
programme.desc: La star del wrestling John Cena in una commedia per tutta la famiglia. Una squadra di vigili del fuoco salva tre fratelli da un incendio in una casa di montagna. In attesa di rintracciare genitori, i pompieri scoprono di non essere affatto addestrati a fare i babysitter.

programme.title: La vigilia di Natale nel Paese delle Meraviglie
programme.desc: La magia del Natale incontra il mondo di "Alice nel paese delle meraviglie" in un'animazione musicale targata Sky Original.

programme.title: Pil's Adventures - Un regno da salvare
programme.desc: Animazione targata Sky Original ambientata nel Medioevo. L'orfanella Pil vive ai margini del regno. Quando pero' il trono viene usurpato, tocca a lei aiutare il legittimo erede.

programme.title: La bussola d'oro

programme.title: Free Willy: Un amico da salvare
programme.desc: L'incredibile storia d'amicizia tra un ragazzino ribelle e un'orca. Incaricato della pulizia di un acquario, Jesse fa amicizia con Willy, un'orca capace di mirabolanti esibizioni.

programme.title: Rosanero

programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

Solo la precaria alleanza proprio con i vampiri, che Blade ha sempre combattuto. potrà dare una speranza all'umanità. programme.desc: Primo film tratto dalla leggendaria serie. Mentre Carrie ha deciso di sposare Mr. Big, Samantha si gode la California, Charlotte adotta una bimba e Miranda e' in crisi con Steve.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Mia moglie è un fantasma
programme.desc: Brillante commedia con Dan Stevens, Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher e Judi Dench basata sull’omonimo racconto. Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Henry Golding in una romantica commedia scandita dalle canzoni di George Michael. Londra: Kate sbarca il lunario lavorando in un negozio durante il periodo natalizio, mentre coltiva il sogno di diventare una cantante. L’incontro con Tom cambierà la sua vita.

programme.title: Lasciarsi un giorno a Roma
programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.title: La verità, vi spiego, sull'amore

programme.title: Le relazioni pericolose
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al film di Stephen Frears dal romanzo di de Laclos, con Glenn Close, John Malkovich, Michelle Pfeiffer e Uma Thurman. Una storia di vendetta e seduzione nella Parigi del '700.

programme.title: Marilyn ha gli occhi neri
programme.desc: Stefano Accorsi e Miriam Leone in una commedia sentimentale. Come terapia riabilitativa, una bugiarda compulsiva e un uomo irascibile dovranno gestire insieme un ristorante.

programme.title: Questo O Quello - Fast & Furious - Ep. 226 - Questo O Quello - Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della spettacolare saga action Fast & Furious, da sabato 20 a venerdì 26 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: La nostra storia
programme.desc: Javier Camara nel racconto di una famiglia e della Colombia degli anni 70 e 80. Tornato a Medellin, Hector evoca la figura del padre, medico e attivista inviso al regime paramilitare.

programme.title: La treccia
programme.desc: Storia di coraggio al femminile di Laetitia Colombani. Legate senza saperlo da ciò che hanno di più prezioso, tre donne decidono di ribellarsi alla sorte che è stata loro assegnata.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: Zero Dark Thirty
programme.desc: 1 Oscar per il thriller di Kathryn Bigelow con Joel Edgerton e Jessica Chastain, premiata ai Golden Globe. Un team della Cia collabora con i Navy Seals per catturare Osama Bin Laden.

programme.title: The Penitent
programme.desc: Luca Barbareschi dirige e interpreta un appassionato dramma, sceneggiato da David Mamet. New York: uno psichiatra ebreo viene travolto da un processo mediatico quando si rifiuta di testimoniare a favore di un suo ex paziente omosessuale che ha compiuto una strage.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto e' Gabriele D'Annunzio nel film di Gianluca Jodice. Brescia, 1936. Un giovane federale e' incaricato dal regime fascista di spiare il grande poeta, in esilio nel Vittoriale.

programme.title: Natale all'improvviso
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e John Goodman in una pellicola natalizia. Tutte le generazioni della famiglia Cooper si ritrovano per Natale, ma quest'anno ognuno di loro ha un segreto da nascondere.

programme.title: Pancho Villa, la leggenda

programme.title: Blackbird - L'ultimo abbraccio

Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.desc: Commedia a episodi di Neri Parenti guidata da Christian De Sica. Due coniugi in balia delle scelte della figlia; la passione di una coppia poco compatibile; un uomo su un'isola senza wi-fi.

programme.title: Una terapia di gruppo
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Claudio Bisio diretta da Paolo Costella. Per errore, sei pazienti ricevono appuntamento dallo psicologo alla stessa ora con esiti inaspettati.

programme.title: Ritorno al crimine
programme.desc: Massimiliano Bruno dirige un grande cast nel sequel targato Sky Original. I 4 amici si ritrovano a Montecarlo sulle tracce della ragazza che aveva rapito il cuore di uno e i soldi di tutti.

programme.title: Il principe abusivo
programme.desc: Commedia fiabesca di e con Alessandro Siani al fianco di Christian De Sica. Ingannato da una principessa, lo squattrinato Antonio stravolge i protocolli di corte con la sua spontaneita'.

programme.title: Trafficanti
programme.desc: Graffiante commedia di Todd Phillips basata su una storia vera, con Jonah Hill e Miles Teller. Due ragazzi firmano un contratto con il Pentagono per armare l'esercito americano in Iraq.

programme.title: Non si ruba a casa dei ladri
programme.desc: Vincenzo Salemme, Massimo Ghini, Stefania Rocca e Manuela Arcuri in una commedia di Carlo Vanzina. Un uomo finito in poverta' organizza una truffa per vendicarsi di chi lo ha rovinato.

programme.title: Il club dei divorziati
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia francese con Arnaud Ducret. Deluso dal tradimento dell'ex moglie di cui e' ancora innamorato, Ben si unisce all'estroverso amico Patrick per godersi i piaceri della vita.

programme.title: Cosa fai a Capodanno?
programme.desc: Luca Argentero, Ilenia Pastorelli e Alessandro Haber in una commedia dai piccanti equivoci. Un gruppo di scambisti si riunisce in una baita di montagna per festeggiare il nuovo anno.

programme.title: Toilet
programme.desc: Commedia di e con Gabriele Pignotta e le voci di Lillo, Francesco Pannofino e Vanessa Incontrada. Un manager in viaggio rimane chiuso nel bagno di una stazione di servizio deserta.

programme.title: Benvenuto Presidente!
programme.desc: Claudio Bisio sale al Quirinale nella commedia di Riccardo Milani con Kasia Smutniak. Per un caso di omonimia, un montanaro patito di pesca viene eletto Presidente della Repubblica.

programme.title: Una terapia di gruppo
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Claudio Bisio diretta da Paolo Costella. Per errore, sei pazienti ricevono appuntamento dallo psicologo alla stessa ora con esiti inaspettati.

programme.title: Se Dio vuole
programme.desc: Marco Giallini e Alessandro Gassmann nella commedia d'esordio di Edoardo Falcone. Un cardiochirurgo ateo entra in crisi quando il figlio annuncia di voler diventare sacerdote.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: Game Night - Indovina chi muore stasera?
programme.desc: Jason Bateman e Rachel McAdams in una mystery-comedy. Un gruppo di amici impegnati in un gioco di societa' scoprono che il crimine su cui stanno indagando per finta e' davvero accaduto.

programme.title: Miami Beach
programme.desc: Ricky Memphis e Max Tortora in una commedia vacanziera di Carlo Vanzina. Le spiagge e il mare della Florida incorniciano le comiche peripezie di un gruppo di ragazzi e dei loro genitori.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson e Zac Efron nell'action comedy ispirata alla serie tv anni '90. Mitch e il suo team di bagnini devono sgominare una pericolosa banda di trafficanti di droga.

programme.title: Piuma
programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una commedia prodotta da Sky Cinema e Palomar. Due diciottenni scoprono di aspettare un figlio e affrontano i mesi piu' emozionanti e complicati della loro vita.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. Tom Thibodeau's Knicks try to maintain the momentum of a gritty 108-105 overtime win in the opener in which they trailed Boston by 20 in the second half. OG Anunoby and Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 29 in the win, which snapped a nine-game home playoff win streak for the Celtics dating back to Game 2 of last spring's second round vs. Cleveland.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Madison Square Garden. New York's series lead is down to 2-1 after a 115-93 loss in Game 3 that drops the Knicks to 1-3 at home this postseason. Boston led wire-to-wire and shot a sizzling 50 percent from beyond the arc, with all five starters sinking a three, plus five from Payton Pritchard (23 points).

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. The Knicks are one win away from their first conference final in a quarter century after fending off Boston 121-113 in Game 4 behind Jalen Brunson's 39 points and 12 assists. Celtics star Jayson Tatum left with a leg injury in the final minutes after pouring in 42 points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 6: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks in Game 6 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Madison Square Garden. Down 3-2, reigning-champion Boston won't go quietly despite losing star forward Jayson Tatum to injury. Jaylen Brown, Derrick White (60 points combined) and reserve center Luke Kornet starred in a 127-102 Game 5 win, delaying New York's bid for its first Eastern final in 25 years.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. Tom Thibodeau's Knicks try to maintain the momentum of a gritty 108-105 overtime win in the opener in which they trailed Boston by 20 in the second half. OG Anunoby and Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 29 in the win, which snapped a nine-game home playoff win streak for the Celtics dating back to Game 2 of last spring's second round vs. Cleveland.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 2 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Top-seeded OKC tries to bounce back from a demoralizing 121-119 loss to the Nuggets in Game 1, which the Thunder led for the entire second half until Aaron Gordon's three in the final seconds. Nikola Jokic amassed team-highs of 42 points, 22 boards, six assists and seven turnovers.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. NBA-champion Boston is up 2-0 as action shifts south to the Magic City, where the C's have lost on their last four regular-season visits. Jaylen Brown's 36 points, 10 boards and five assists keyed a 109-100 win in Game 2 with sidekick Jayson Tatum sidelined (wrist). Orlando's Paolo Banchero scored 32 in defeat.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Kia Center. Boston's losing streak on the Magic's homecourt is at five after a 95-93 loss in Game 3 that cut the Celtics' series lead to 2-1. Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown combined for 55 points but also 13 of Boston's 21 turnovers. Franz Wagner's 32 points and eight assists led Orlando.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves
programme.desc: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 1 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Target Center. Chris Finch's T-Wolves enjoy homecourt to start just their third-ever conference semifinal, a round Steph Curry and Golden State have reached for the eighth time in 11 years. Former Minnesota guard Jimmy Butler (2017-19) adds experience to the Warrior lineup that went seven games in Round 1, while the T-Wolves dispatched the Lakers in five.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors in Game 3 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Chase Center. With the series tied 1-1, Anthony Edwards and the T-Wolves hit the road, where they are an impressive 8-3 in the postseason since last spring. Golden State was hamstrung by Steph Curry's absence in Game 2, falling 117-93, with 20 turnovers. Julius Randle's 24 points led Minnesota.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors in Game 4 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Chase Center. The T-Wolves have a 2-1 series edge and are a remarkable 9-3 on the road in the last two postseasons, after surging late in Game 3 in San Francisco for a 102-97 win. Julius Randle logged a triple double, while Anthony Edwards scored a game-high 36.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves
programme.desc: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 5 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Target Center. Anthony Edwards and the T-Wolves are up 3-1 on Golden State, who've lost three in a row for the first time since December as Steph Curry sits with a hamstring injury. Julius Randle joined Edwards with 30-plus points in Game 4, the first T-Wolves playoff duo to do that since 2004 (Kevin Garnett and Sam Cassell).

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers
programme.desc: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Indy raced to a 1-0 series lead with a 117-98 win three days ago, fueled by Pascal Siakam's 25 points. Giannis Antetokounmpo (36 points) was just 8-for-15 on free throws for Milwaukee, which led the league in three-point percentage but was 9-for-37 in Game 1.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Indiana Pacers at Milwaukee Bucks
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Milwaukee Bucks in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Fiserv Forum. Doc Rivers' Bucks have work to do down 2-0 in this rematch from last year's first round, with six of the eight total meetings between the teams decided by double-digits. Indy never trailed in a 123-115 Game 2 win, sinking all 19 of its free throws as both sides shot well throughout.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers
programme.desc: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Indiana is a win away from its second straight first-round dispatching of the Bucks after scorching the nets with 60.2 percent shooting in a 129-103 Game 4 triumph. Myles Turner had 23 points (and four blocks) to lead eight double-figure scorers for the Pacers, who sank 18 threes.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 1 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. Fourth-year star Cade Cunningham heads the Pistons' first playoff squad in six years, and averaged 30.8 points and 8.3 assists vs. New York this season as Detroit went 2-0 at MSG. Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns pace the Knicks in the teams' first playoff meeting since 1992.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 1 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. The top-seeded Thunder return to action after eight off days, facing interim coach David Adelman's Nuggets, who are fresh off winning a seven-game slugfest vs. the Clippers. MVP candidates Nikola Jokic and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander star in the teams first playoff meeting since 2011, when OKC got its first postseason series win since moving from Seattle.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets in Game 3 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Ball Arena. The series is knotted at 1-1 as top-seeded OKC rolls into the Mile High City for the first time since early November, following a resounding 149-106 win in Game 2. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander tallied 34 points in just 30 minutes, with his team scoring an NBA playoff record 87 first-half points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets in Game 4 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Ball Arena. A battle-tested Nuggets squad won Game 3 in overtime to take a 2-1 series lead on green, top-seeded OKC. Jamal Murray (27 pts., 4 steals) and Aaron Gordon sparked Denver while big man Nikola Jokic struggled (0-for-10 on threes, 8 turnovers). Jalen Williams' 32 points paced the Thunder.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 5 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Mark Daigneault's Thunder return home tied 2-2 as they've disrupted Denver big man Nikola Jokic into more turnovers (23) than assists (22) through four games. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had nine of his 25 points late in a 92-87 Game 4 win, in which OKC also had a 35-8 edge in bench scoring.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. The Pistons try again to end their 15-game playoff losing streak after falling 123-112 in Game 1 in the Big Apple, crumbling by 40-21 in the fourth quarter. Jalen Brunson's 34 led New York, while Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby combined for nine steals, four blocks and 46 points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. J.B. Bickerstaff's Pistons return to the Motor City as playoff winners for the first time in 17 years following a 100-94 triumph in Game 2 that knotted the series at 1-1. Cade Cunningham piled up 33 points and 12 boards in the win, while Jalen Brunson's 37 went for naught.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. J.B. Bickerstaff's Pistons trail 2-1 in the series and are a loss away from matching the league record of nine for consecutive home playoff losses, set by the 76ers (1968-71). Karl-Anthony Towns (31 points) and Jalen Brunson (30) carried New York in a 118-116 Game 3 victory.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. Tom Thibodeau's Knicks pulled out two razor-thin wins in Motown to take a 3-1 series lead, as Cade Cunningham and Detroit look to punch back at MSG. Jalen Brunson (32 points, 11 assists) and Karl-Anthony Towns (27 points) led the way in Game 4, which also saw a last-second non-call go New York's way on a three-point shot by Tim Hardaway Jr.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. Tom Thibodeau's Knicks try to maintain the momentum of a gritty 108-105 overtime win in the opener in which they trailed Boston by 20 in the second half. OG Anunoby and Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 29 in the win, which snapped a nine-game home playoff win streak for the Celtics dating back to Game 2 of last spring's second round vs. Cleveland.

programme.sub-title: Game 2: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 2 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Nikola Jokic amassed team-highs of 42 points, 22 boards, six assists and seven turnovers.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 6: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 6 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. The visitors have won four of five games in this series as New York takes a 3-2 edge back to Motown, where the Pistons have lost an NBA record-tying nine straight playoff games. Third-year center Jalen Duren had nine points, 14 boards and six assists in Detroit's 106-103 Game 5 win.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets in Game 1 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Ball Arena. Ty Lue's Clippers sail into the playoffs on an eight-game win streak, boasting the third-best FG pct. defense (39.5) in the league as they battle superstar Nikola Jokic, the third player ever to average a triple-double for an NBA season. Fellow Euro Ivica Zubac patrols the paint for L.A.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets in Game 2 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Ball Arena. Denver's Russell Westbrook stung his previous Clippers mates with late clutch play in a 112-110 Game 1 overtime win. Nikola Jokic chipped in three of the Nuggets' 11 steals, to go with a game-high 29 points and 12 assists. James Harden's 32 points topped L.A., which blew a 15-point lead.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Clippers
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Clippers in Game 4 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Intuit Dome. L.A. is up 2-1 in a best-of-seven that began with two nail-biting finishes in Denver before the Clippers sailed to a 117-83 Game 3 win in their raucous new home in Inglewood. Nic Batum had four of L.A.'s 18 made three-pointers, to just seven for the Nuggets.

programme.title: CSI S5 E18 - Spark of Life
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: Extreme Ends

programme.title: Herbal Symphony #2 Summer
programme.desc: In Uda, discover Japan's oldest private medicinal herb garden, where the natural landscape from 300 years ago is preserved in a botanical time capsule, a sanctuary of the local culture and history.

programme.title: JAPAN DELISH 5min.
programme.desc: Curry rice, one of Japan's most iconic national dishes. How did Jimbocho, Tokyo become a curry town?

programme.title: TOSA: Cape of Faith
programme.desc: Cape Ashizuri is marked by rugged cliffs and peculiar rocks. A strong current off its coast has been the cause of many accidents. Enjoy the scenery at the cape, a place of worship, in time-lapse.

programme.title: Seasoning the Seasons
programme.desc: This program visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nation's long history.

programme.desc:
This is a story of revenge by Norman Dela Cruz, a 
loving son, and he aspires to become a lawyer for 
the underprivileged. After his mother was killed, he 
vowed to seek revenge against the influential 
retired judge, Benito Balmores.

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 12
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

business. Are the parents willing to accept change 
and innovations of the new generation?

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: Ny Knicks – Indiana G3
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers i New York Knicks susrest će se 26. svibnja 2025. godine u trećoj međusobnoj utakmici finalne serije NBA Istočne konferencije.

programme.title: When The Garden Was Eden
programme.desc: U 70-im godinama prošlog stoljeća, u vrijeme kad je SAD bio politički i ideološki podijeljen, košarkaši New York Knicksa pokazali su koliko znači sloga.

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: Ny Knicks – Boston G3
programme.desc: New York Knicks i Boston Celtics igrat će međusobno 10. svibnja 2025. treću međusobnu utakmicu četvrtfinalnog doigravanja Istočne konferencije. Tko će iz Madison Square Garden izaći kao pobjednik?

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: Finale – Okc – Indiana G4
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers i Oklahoma City Thunder odigrat će četvrtu međusobnu utakmicu 14. lipnja 2025. u dvorani Gainbridge Fieldhouse u sklopu finalne serije NBA lige. Obje ekipe priželjkuju slavlje.

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: Denver – La Clippers G4
programme.desc: La Clippers će igrati protiv Denver Nuggetsa 27. travnja 2025. u sportskoj dvorani Intuit Dome tijekom četvrte utakmice prve runde doigravanja Zapadne Konferencije. Obje ekipe žele slaviti.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Streak
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film fokusira se na četiri fotografa: Johna Bievera, Waltera Ioossa, Mickeya Palmera i Tonyja Tomsica koji su sudjelovali na 48 Super Bowl igara u periodu od 1967. godine do 2014.

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: Finale Zapada – Okc – Minnesota G4
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves i Oklahoma City Thunder suočit će se 27. svibnja 2025. u četvrtoj utakmici finalne serije Zapadne konferencije NBA lige. Tko će pokazati bolju igru i odnijeti pobjedu?

programme.title: Baseball – Mlb: Ny Mets – San Diego
programme.desc: New York Mets suočit će se s San Diego Padresima u MLB utakmici. Tko će pobijediti na stadionu Citi Field? Susret počinje u 19:10.

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: La Lakers – Minnesota G4
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves i LA Lakers odmjerit će snage 27. travnja 2025. u četvrtoj međusobnoj utakmici doigravanja NBA lige. Tko će izaći kao pobjednik iz Target centra? Susret započinje u 21:30.

programme.title: Košarka – Nba Liga: Denver – La Clippers G5
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets će se suočiti s La Clippersima 29. travnja 2025. u petoj međusobnoj i odlučujućoj utakmici NBA doigravanja. Tko će slaviti u Ball Areni? Utakmica će započeti u 22:00 sata.

programme.title: Nba Classic Game
programme.desc: Portland – Detroit 1990.. NBA Classic Game donosi snimke legendarnih košarkaških utakmica iz NBA lige koje su ostale upamćene po nevjerojatnim obratima, vrhunskoj igri i genijalnim ubačajima.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: When in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max, a wanderer, joins the rebel warrior Imperator Furiosa against his will in order to dethrone an autocrat who controls water supply to the land.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: An ex-MI6 agent steals a hard drive with top-secret information to carry out a vendetta on Bond's overseer, M. Bond must face his past in a bid to try and save M.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: Nick works as a bodyguard while trying to overcome his gambling addiction. However, his life takes a turn when he learns of a brutal attack on his friend and sets out on a bloody quest for revenge.

programme.title: The Pilgrim
